title: a draft's status is exactly draft: approved, candidate, retired or a missing status are rejected, so a draft cannot pass as a saved build
source: intended: docs/decisions.md D7 and the drafts rows of the other decisions (a just-in-time build is a draft kept in .jitso/drafts/ and validated by code)
intent: INTENDED behavior (defect N-15, drafts; docs/decisions.md D7). `status: draft` is valid only in the draft layer and the draft layer accepts nothing else: any other status, or none, is `status must be draft in a draft`. The rest of the file is valid, so that is the only problem.

steps.stdin:
# Draft written by a drafts case.
id: scout
version: 1
status: {{status}}
role: operator
type: scanner
work_kind: repo-scan
description: Scan the repo for TODO comments and report them.
harness: claude
model: claude-haiku-5-5
effort: low
mode_default: direct
agents_md: exclude
route_scope: [none]
skills_first: []
tools: [Read, Glob, Grep]
mcp: []
requires: []
budget: { tokens: 150000, usd_list_cap: 0.30 }

stderr.equals: JITSO REJECTED: draft stdin is invalid: status must be draft in a draft
